one_idea.description: True when the item states exactly one idea

ideas.description: When one_idea is true: the one idea, restated in the team's words. When false: each separate idea, one entry each

terms.description: Each domain word of the idea, with the word the team uses for it and where the team's word is written

team_word.description: The team's word; the same word when they agree

duplicates.description: Other items on the line that ask for the same thing; empty when there are none

item.description: The other item's number, from items.json

related.description: Requirements, decision records and archived changes that concern the same thing

reversed_decisions.description: Standing decisions the idea, as stated, would reverse; empty when there are none

questions_for_requester.description: Only what must be answered before the item states one idea a person can admit; empty when nothing is missing

open_points.description: Points for the person who admits the item to know. Not questions the line needs answered now

gaps.description: What the constitution lacks for this read, for example no glossary; empty when it lacks nothing

summary.description: Two sentences at most, for the person who admits
